text:
sam: Heads-up — HelioHealth opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-0510. They say a staging flag was left enabled and generated automated retries during onboarding, causing a usage spike. Asking for a remedial credit and Net45 for two invoices while they stabilize.
maya: How big is the dispute? Need exact amounts + docs.
sam: Requesting $38,250 credit (they uploaded a CSV usage extract). Current outstanding for INV-2026-0510 = $96,750. They propose the credit be applied to that invoice and the balance net of credit paid on Net45 terms for invoice INV-2026-0511 and INV-2026-0512.
toni: From Sales: customer is high-touch and renewal in 5 weeks. Recommend one-time credit to reduce churn; ask for written acknowledgement that they’ll close the retry issue.
luis: From RevOps: if we grant $38.25k, tag GL: 4802_customer_recovery and reason code: onboarding_retry_loop. We need Finance approval and Legal signoff for payment-term exception.
maya: Finance questions: 1) Do we treat this as a contra-revenue adjustment this quarter? 2) Require amendment before changing collection status?
sam: Helio says if we issue the credit now they will mark the dispute resolved and supply a signable amendment within 48 hrs.
legal-bot: Legal review requested. Suggested amendment: single paragraph addendum granting Net45 for invoices INV-2026-0511 and INV-2026-0512 only; no changes to pricing, SLAs, or termination. Add clause: credit is one-time and does not set precedent.
maya: Proposed workflow: - Approve one-time customer_recovery credit of $38,250. - Apply credit to INV-2026-0510, issue corrected invoice and place original invoice in "adjusted" status. - Grant Net45 for the next two invoices conditional on countersigned amendment within 72 hours. - Collections: hold further Dunning while amendment outstanding.
luis: I'll prepare the internal revenue memo and update AR aging once corrected invoice posted. Please confirm accounting code and memo text.
maya: Approved under standard discretionary limits. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead). Conditions: signed amendment within 72 hours; add a one-time waiver note in customer file; escalate if Helio requests any further retro credits.
sam: I'll send the amendment and attach the usage CSV. Also asked customer for a post-mortem with remediation steps.
toni: Can we add a protective clause: if additional unapproved retro credits are requested later, escalate to VP-Finance?
maya: Yes, include escalation clause. Also cap total retro credits for this account at $50k for the 12-month window unless VP approval.
billing-bot: INV-2026-0510 link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0510 — balance $96,750. Collections: paused pending adjustment.
legal-bot: Amendment draft attached. Requesting e-signature flow to HelioHealth.
sam: Thanks — I'll coordinate signature and confirm when amendment received. Closing here once signed. :white_check_mark:
